items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: So somebody told him about Harry Carney and me being saxophonists. So he hired us right away.

ctx.x: Well, who gave you the tenor?

It was a European tenor... It was Elmer Williams' tenor. Elmer was the tenor player with Chick's band. See, they wanted a relief band to play one hour up there, the dinner hour, you know... So Reynolds, Elbrook(?) Reynolds, he got the band. And he came around the Rhythm Club (not the Rhythm Club), the Band Box at that time to get some musicians.
